Selected HP/extracted-ASBS+GIS2024, f=0, zero-spin v0.3 research draft. Distinct from generic GIS discovery and IGS97/ISA. Pending unsigned source review; strict computed norm(h)<=R without projection. Illustrative full state is not prepared/calibrated. Tiny-path qualification only; ordinary 1%/100step/depth14 run fails; use the explicitly labelled small run example. Local browser acceptance pending.

Definition, conventions & preparation

Definition status: draft. Browser availability does not establish scientific review or experimental validation. Consult retained evidence for review scope and decisions.

Flattened selected HP/extracted-ASBS+GIS source rates; stress6,e,h6,Omega. Explicit18 physical parameters plus numerical stress scale. Zero spin, no hidden preparation or clamping, no author-code algorithm equivalence or experimental validation. Initial state is a software fixture; source preparation must be supplied explicitly. The full pairing requires computed memory norm <= R with no enlarged tolerance shell; exact sphere arithmetic and finite integration remain explicit verification gates.
